display.purpose: Section headings on sand, two-line uppercase stacks; no label above.

title.purpose: Product names, gift strip and gift-box tile headings, box steps; scaled up for the feature card and fit headings.

body.purpose: Running copy, 30-52ch, muted on light / muted-dark on board.

caption.purpose: Sentence-case labels: legends, field labels, table heads, footer heads, the hero length-rule label, figure captions, small text actions.

label.purpose: Uppercase, only for buttons, nav links and photo badges.

label-cta.purpose: Every gold button; 0.875rem with 0.08em tracking in the banderol below sm.

numeral.purpose: Prices, size codes, measurements, size table, height input.

arabic.purpose: Arabic greeting in the box section only.

shadows.name: lid-cast
shadows.purpose: Only on the lifting lid in LidReveal; the system's single drop shadow.

shadows.name: gold-inset-rule
shadows.purpose: Second hairline marking an active choice on board (1.5px on the gift-box option). Not elevation.

shadows.name: ink-inset-rule
shadows.purpose: Second hairline on a focused field on light ground (checkout, Mollie card fields). Not elevation.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: House easing: hero rise/settle, card picker, cart progress.

motion.name: ease-out-quick
motion.purpose: Accordion (open 260ms / close 180ms), sheet entry, header hide.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Hero entrance only; h1 uses rise-y (position only) so the LCP heading is visible at once.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Hero thobe photo coming to rest in its studio panel.

motion.name: lid-reveal
motion.purpose: The one authored scroll moment; mounted after paint, never under reduced motion.

motion.name: diagram-spring
motion.purpose: Size worksheet morph (figures, length and chest lines) and the header's active nav rule.

motion.name: crossfade
motion.purpose: Product card photo swap on hover, fine pointers only.

narrative.overview:
The site is the THOBY3 box. Sections outside the box sit on sand: the hero with the thobe at full length, the collection, the reviews, the size map, the FAQ. Sections inside the box sit on matte black board with real cardboard grain: the header bar, the hero banderol, the box section, the footer. Gold foil is scarce and literal. It marks the kufi emblem, the hairlines along the banderol and the bar edges, the one gold-filled action in a region, and the choice the visitor has just made.

The forms come from the packaging and the pattern table. Corners are square. Lines are thin. Headings are narrow uppercase stacks like the print inside the lid. Buttons and nav read like hang tags; everything else that labels (legends, field labels, table heads, small print) is a quiet sentence-case caption. Size codes look like woven neck labels. Photography is real product and real box. Studio packshots sit on a pale studio ground and blend into it with multiply; the hero thobe stands in a panel of its own photo's grey with a measured length rule on it. Measurement is drawn, not claimed: rules with end ticks, dimension lines in gold ink, a 10 cm grid. Depth comes from changing ground (sand, paper, board), never from shadow. The one cast shadow belongs to the lid as it lifts off.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds tell the story: sand is outside the box, grained board is inside it.
Gold marks the emblem, hairlines, the one primary action and the active choice. Nothing else.
Every corner is square. No pills, no radius.
Headings are two-line uppercase Big Shoulders stacks, with no label above them.
Uppercase is for buttons, nav and photo badges; other labels are sentence-case captions.
Size codes run S-1 to XL-2 (-1 slim, -2 broad) and are the product's own vocabulary.
Length and width are shown as drawn measurements (length rule, dimension lines, true-scale figures).

rules.name: The One Burning Plane Rule
rules.body: Gold lights up only what matters right now: the emblem, the hairlines, the one gold-filled action in a region, and the active choice. It is never used for headings, labels, numerals, prices or table column heads. Those stay in ink, paper or muted. Gold ink is the measuring pen, not the foil: it draws dimensions on light ground and never fills an action.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Sand means outside the box. Board means inside it. A section takes one ground or the other, with paper as the only layer laid on sand. Board is never shown without its grain. The hero's studio panel is a photograph's own ground, not a third ground.

rules.name: The Ground-Aware Choice Rule
rules.body: On board, an active choice is a gold outline: gold border plus a 1px inset gold rule (`box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--gold)`), with gold text and no fill. On sand or paper, an active choice is an ink fill with gold lettering.

rules.name: The Lid Print Rule
rules.body: A section heading is a two-line uppercase display stack and starts its section. There is no eyebrow, kicker or category label above it.

rules.name: The Hang Tag Is for Actions Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked Big Shoulders labels mark things you press or navigate to: buttons, nav links, photo badges. Everything else that names a field, a column, a legend or a footer group is a sentence-case caption in the body face.

rules.name: The Neck Label Rule
rules.body: Sizes are written as codes (S-1, S-2, M-1 to XL-2), where -1 means slim and -2 means broad. They are set in numerals, never spelled out as words.

rules.name: The Only Shadow Is the Box's Rule
rules.body: The lid's cast shadow is the system's only drop shadow. Everything else stays flat.

dos: **Do** set every section on either sand (outside the box) or grained board (inside it), with paper as the only layer on sand.
**Do** keep one gold-filled action per region, and make active choices a gold outline on board or an ink fill with gold text on light ground.
**Do** write section headings as two-line uppercase display stacks and start the section with them.
**Do** use the uppercase label only for buttons, nav links and photo badges, and the sentence-case caption for every other label.
**Do** write sizes as codes (S-1 to XL-2) in tabular Big Shoulders numerals.
**Do** show measurement as drawn rules with end ticks, in ink on photos and gold ink on the pattern sheet.
**Do** blend studio packshots into the studio grey with multiply, and give a hero photo its own measured ground.

**Do** limit entrance motion to the hero's rise/settle (500ms and 1600ms, `cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)`), keep the lid reveal as the one scroll-linked moment, and gate all motion behind prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: **Don't** use gold foil for headings, labels, numerals, prices or column heads.
**Don't** round a corner or use a pill shape.
**Don't** add drop shadows. The lid's cast shadow is the only one.
**Don't** put an eyebrow, kicker or category label above a heading.
**Don't** set legends, field labels, table heads or footer column heads in uppercase tracked type.
**Don't** show board without its grain, or put board text in anything but paper, muted-dark or gold.
**Don't** mark errors with a coloured side stripe or tinted fill; use a full 1px danger border.
